# Refinzi 2.0 — Ambient AI Prompt Builder for Windows

> Refinzi 2.0 is an ambient Windows desktop companion that transforms vague, unstructured prompts into production-grade prompts in 2 seconds directly in-place across any Windows application.

## Quick Summary
- **Platform**: Windows 10 & Windows 11 (64-bit).
- **Core Workflow**: 1-Click on floating Orb (or press `Ctrl+Alt+Space`) to rebuild active text in-place.
- **Secondary Workflow**: Hold Orb for 300ms to generate complete 5-Block Architectural Blueprints.
- **Privacy & Security**: 100% Local-first. Zero prompt logging. API keys encrypted on-device via Windows DPAPI (AES-256).
- **Pricing**: Free BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) forever ($0) or Lifetime Pro ($12 USD / ₹999 INR one-time payment).

## Key Links & Documentation
- [Official Website](https://refinzi.com): Main product hub and interactive demo.
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://refinzi.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed architectural specifications and AI engine guide.
- [User Manual & Documentation](https://refinzi.com/docs/): Complete shortcut guide, BYOK instructions, and model settings.
- [Pricing Matrix](https://refinzi.com/#pricing): Breakdown between Free BYOK ($0) and Lifetime Pro ($12).
- [Interactive Demo](https://refinzi.com/#demo): Live comparisons for ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Cursor, and Higgsfield AI.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/papada1472/refinzi): Open-source core, release notes, and issue tracker.
- [Windows Installer (.exe)](https://github.com/papada1472/refinzi/releases/download/v2.0.0/Refinzi-Setup-v2.0.0.exe): Direct setup binary.

## Supported AI Models & Routing
- **DeepSeek**: DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1 (Reasoning).
- **Anthropic**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Pro managed routing).
- **OpenAI**: GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini.
- **Google**: Gemini 1.5 Flash, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Gemini 2.0.
- **OpenRouter & NVIDIA**: Nemotron 70B/120B, Mistral Large, Llama 3.3 70B.

## 5-Block Blueprint Engine
When activated via 300ms Hold or secondary hotkey, Refinzi outputs 5 comprehensive blocks:
1. **Structure & Section Hierarchy**: Semantic layout, component boundaries, responsive grids.
2. **Component Assets & Design Tokens**: HSL color scales, typography rules, glassmorphism specs.
3. **High-Converting Copy & Creative Hooks**: Headlines, body copy, sub-bullets, and CTA variations.
4. **Motion & Micro-Interactions**: Hover transitions, spring animations, entry choreography.
5. **Production Prompt Pack**: Calibrated for Cursor rules, Claude artifacts, ChatGPT or v0.
